goal: Let GUI users export transactions as PSBTv0 by default with an option for PSBTv2
Fixes signing failures on external hardware wallets that do not support PSBTv2
agreement: Unaddressed objection: adding UI controls and translation strings is unfit for backports (achow101)
Suggests hardcoding PSBTv0 in the GUI instead of adding a toggleable checkbox (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because defaulting to PSBTv2 breaks signing on external hardware wallets that only support PSBTv0
Restores external signer interoperability for users exporting transactions from the GUI
